summary: Full-stack testing of the new Voices from the Street + Miracle Mailbox features. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (mailbox generate/get/delete/404/visit-count, MM-[A-Z2-9]{5} pattern with no confusing chars, voices submit/approve/delete lifecycle, public list, migration SQL download). Frontend: all data-testids present on /voices, /voices/record (with ref query param preserved), /mailbox/:code (both valid + not-found states). Admin dashboard: deep-links ?tab=voices and ?tab=mailbox open the right panels; all 8 tabs (donations, volunteers, contacts, prayers, notary, resources, voices, mailbox) clickable; generator flow (fill 5, generate, print modal opens, delete row) works end-to-end; QR generator toggle renders qrcode.react SVG and updates when ref changes. Header 'Voices' link present. No blocking issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Both data-testid='voices-empty' and empty data-testid='voices-list' <div> render simultaneously when items.length===0. Not visually broken (empty grid has 0 children) but the list container should conditionally render only when items exist for cleaner DOM.

issues: React hydration warnings in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <select>/<tbody>/<option>'. Root cause is the preview-only Emergent dev instrumentation wrapping mapped children in <span data-ve-dynamic='true' x-excluded='true' style='display:contents'>. This does NOT affect the production Cloudflare build (instrumentation is stripped), so it is a preview environment artifact only, not application code. Called out for transparency.

action_items: Optional cleanup: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Voices.jsx, wrap the voices-list <div> in `{items.length > 0 && ...}` so the empty state and the (empty) grid don't co-exist in the DOM. Cosmetic only.
No other action items — feature is production-ready for the preview backend contract. Whisper transcription + R2 audio playback remain Cloudflare-only as documented.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py has grown to 458 lines with in-memory stubs interleaved with real MongoDB routes; the Voices+Mailbox stubs (~140 lines) should be extracted to /app/backend/voices_mailbox_stub.py for maintainability once the file crosses ~600 lines. Currently under the 700-line threshold so acceptable.

_VOICES_CACHE and _MAILBOX_CACHE are module-level dicts — will be wiped on every backend restart / worker reboot. This is documented in code comments and expected in preview, but new engineers might be surprised. Consider a `# PREVIEW-ONLY: ephemeral in-memory cache` banner at the top of that section.

stub_mailbox_generate uses random.choice from Python's default (not-cryptographic) random module for MM code generation. Fine for preview (collision handling is present with 5-try retry), but production Worker in cloudflare-backend/src/index.ts should use crypto.getRandomValues to avoid predictable codes.

MailboxTab.jsx voice-qr-toggle: the QR points-to URL is built with `${window.location.origin}/voices/record?ref=...` — good, but the ref input has no validation (spaces or special chars would produce a broken URL). Consider basic sanitization.
Voices.jsx renders both voices-empty and an empty voices-list <div>. Minor DOM cleanliness issue (see UI bug above).

seed_data_creation: During backend tests, 3 mailbox codes were generated via the admin API and 1 was deleted (2 remain). One voice testimony was submitted + approved + deleted. During frontend tests, 5 more mailbox codes were generated via UI and 1 was deleted (4 remain). All test data is in-memory only and will vanish on next backend restart.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview backend cache is in-memory — expect stale mailbox codes / voices to persist across a single supervisor process lifetime but disappear on restart. When testing on production Cloudflare, replace endpoints with the Worker URL and admin routes require admin JWT (Bearer token from /api/admin/login). Whisper transcription (env.AI + @cf/openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo) and R2 audio storage only exist in the Worker path, so audio playback of approved voices will not work in preview — the audio_url field stays empty and mailbox_voice.audio_key falls back to a /api/voices/audio/:id endpoint that returns 404 in preview.
playbook_notes: qrcode.react v4.2.0 renders as an inline SVG (46 SVGs on the admin Mailbox tab confirmed). The QR SVG regenerates client-side on ref input change without a network call — good UX.
